data.current_summary: Gate 1: submit a claim and enter the human queue
data.current_description:
Submits work for a human and admits it to the queue.

Every admission is paid, and every caller first receives a 402. A wallet with an earned admission credit signs that 402 as usual: Verifi checks that the signature comes from agent_id, for the admission price of a valid quote, then uses the credit, answers 202, and never submits the payment. A signature from any other wallet is settled as a normal payment, so nobody can spend another wallet's credit. Its PAYMENT-REQUIRED header carries two exact options for 0.10 EUR, USDC first (converted at the ECB euro reference rate, rounded up to the cent) and EURC second, and the full terms of the chain in extensions["service-windows"]: both windows, the unlock prices for each asset, the conversion, and terms_valid_until. Pick one option, sign it with the requester wallet, and repeat the same request while the quote is valid (about 10 minutes). A payment signed against an expired quote is not settled: the answer is a fresh 402 with fresh terms.

The asset paid here binds the chain, and the unlock is paid in the same asset. The unlock costs 1.45 to 2.90 EUR, decided by when the human answered: 2.90 EUR if ready_at is within 60 minutes of admitted_at, 1.45 EUR if it is later, within 24 hours. There is no cancellation. If nobody answers within 24 hours the chain fails with reason human_timeout and the wallet's next admission is free.

A paid chain does not enter the human queue before its admission settlement is recorded. A refused request never charges the caller: x402 cancels settlement for any 4xx or 5xx answer, so the signed authorization is never submitted. This endpoint therefore answers 402 whenever the caller has no entitlement, including while the human queue is full, and answers 400, 409, or a full queue 503 only after the payment gate. When no quote can be issued it answers 503 instead of 402.

Store verify_id from the response. It is the only durable handle for the rest of the chain.
data.summary_suggestion: Submit verification request and pay gate 1 admission fee
data.description_suggestion:
Submits a verification request for human judgment and initiates the three-gate payment chain. This is gate 1 (admission gate, 0.10 EUR).

Expects a VerifyRequest body with the claim details. Returns 402 Payment Required on first call with two payment options (USDC or EURC, both 0.10 EUR equivalent) and full chain terms in extensions["service-windows"]. Sign the 402 with your wallet and resubmit the same request to settle payment.

On successful payment settlement, returns 202 Accepted with verify_id (required for polling and unlock). The asset paid at gate 1 binds the entire chain—unlock must be paid in the same asset.

If your wallet has an earned admission credit, sign the 402 and Verifi will use the credit instead of settling payment. Payments from other wallets are always settled normally.

Side effects: Admission is recorded only after payment settlement. If no human answers within 24 hours, the chain fails with reason human_timeout and your next admission becomes free. Store verify_id—it is the only durable handle for the rest of the chain.

data.current_summary: Poll the state of a chain
data.current_description:
Returns the current state. Polling never costs money and never reveals a locked result.

While status is processing, honor retry_after_seconds. A processing response carries admitted_at, sla_deadline, and grace_deadline, so the agent can plan its polling; expires_at equals grace_deadline, the last deadline. Human work can take minutes or hours, up to 24 hours, so do not assume a short fixed deadline. Prefer callback_url and use polling as the recovery path.

A ready response states exactly what the unlock costs and why: service_window.applied (sla or grace, decided by ready_at alone) and service_window.unlock_amount in the bound asset.
data.summary_suggestion: Check verification chain status and unlock cost
data.description_suggestion:
Returns the current state of a verification chain identified by verify_id. Polling is free and never reveals locked results.

Expects verify_id as a path parameter. Returns 200 with VerifyState containing: status (processing, ready, or failed), admitted_at, and deadline information.

While status is processing: Response includes sla_deadline (60 minutes from admission), grace_deadline (24 hours from admission), and retry_after_seconds. Honor retry_after_seconds for polling intervals. Human work can take minutes to hours—do not assume short deadlines.

When status is ready: Response includes service_window (showing applied window: sla or grace, decided by ready_at timestamp) and unlock_amount in the bound asset. This tells you exactly what gate 2 (unlock) will cost and why.

When status is failed: Response includes failure_info with reason (e.g., human_timeout).

Side effects: None—polling never costs money and never changes state. Prefer callback_url over polling when available; use polling as recovery path only.

data.current_summary: Gates 2 and 3: unlock the ready human result
data.current_description:
Call this only when status is ready. Before that the endpoint answers 409 and asks for no payment.

Without ?id= naming a chain, or with an unknown id, the endpoint answers 402 with the unlock price band: every accepted asset at both the SLA and the grace price, from the current quote. That 402 describes the prices; it unlocks nothing. A payment made against it is refused with 400 or 404 and never settled.

The unlock costs 1.45 to 2.90 EUR, decided by when the human answered: 2.90 EUR (SLA price) if ready_at is within 60 minutes of admitted_at, 1.45 EUR (grace price) if it is later, within 24 hours. A boundary instant belongs to the earlier window. When the agent polls or unlocks does not change the price.

The endpoint answers 402 with exactly one exact requirement: the asset the admission was paid in, at service_window.unlock_amount. With 1 EUR = 1.17 USD that is 3400000 (SLA) or 1700000 (grace) atomic USDC, and 2900000 or 1450000 atomic EURC. Its extensions["service-windows"].info repeats terms_id, applied, admitted_at, ready_at, network, asset, and unlock_amount, so the agent can check the arithmetic against the terms it paid for at admission. Refuse to sign if the asset differs or the amount is higher than the bound amount for the applied window. Sign the requirement with the requester wallet and repeat the same request. An admission credit never covers this gate.

The result body is released only after the unlock settlement succeeds. Unlocking twice does not charge twice: once the chain is completed, the answer is returned without a new payment.
data.summary_suggestion: Pay gates 2 and 3 to unlock human verdict and response
data.description_suggestion:
Unlocks the human verdict and response after payment of gates 2 and 3 (combined unlock cost: 1.45–2.90 EUR depending on response time).

Prerequisite: Call only when getVerify returns status=ready. Calling before ready returns 409 Conflict with no payment required.

Required parameters: id (verify_id from createVerify). Returns 402 Payment Required with unlock cost and terms.

Payment requirement: The 402 specifies exactly one asset (the same asset paid at gate 1 admission) and unlock_amount in atomic units. SLA price (2.90 EUR / ~3,400,000 atomic USDC) applies if human answered within 60 minutes of admission; grace price (1.45 EUR / ~1,700,000 atomic USDC) applies if answered later, within 24 hours. The applied window is decided by ready_at timestamp alone, not by when you unlock.

Validation before signing: Check that extensions["service-windows"].info.asset matches your admission asset and unlock_amount does not exceed the bound amount for the applied window. Refuse to sign if either check fails.

Sign the 402 with your requester wallet and resubmit the same request. Admission credits do not cover this gate.

On successful settlement, returns 200 with verdict, explanation, and full response. Unlocking twice does not charge twice—once completed, the answer is returned without new payment.

Side effects: Settles payment for gates 2 and 3. Releases the human verdict and response only after settlement succeeds.
